map_magN17_cw.desc: On the sheet: 0 = printed N arrow (map-up) turned 17 deg clockwise (1970 declination); k rad clockwise; n paper inches (bar-label calibration); paper -> ground by the georeference

map_drawn0_cw.desc: On the sheet: 0 = the Zodiac's drawn 0-arm as drawn (3.0 deg cw of map-up), clockwise

map_trueN_magN_cw.desc: On the sheet: 0 = real 1970 magnetic north drawn correctly on this map (true north is 4.6 deg cw of map-up), clockwise

map_magN17_cw_ruler.desc: as map_magN17_cw with the ruler-photo inch (127.4 px/in instead of 124.4)

geo_magN_cw_6p4.desc: Solver convention: true bearing = 16.88 + k rad (clockwise); ground distance = n * 6.4 mi

geo_magN_cw_true_scale.desc: true bearing = 16.88 + k rad; ground distance = n * 7.01 mi (what a paper inch covers on this map)
